reviews.classification: full historical premise and mechanism synthesis
reviews.disposition:
F1: Full actual review covers the168-line synthesis, P1–P10, M1–M7, both templates, all seven world-audit rows, cross-world candidates and source limits/index. Preserve these as premise and mechanism palettes. Its eight-survey/about230-works claim, mixed quick scans, praise/pitfall judgments and source-reading statements are dated aggregate reports, not proof of eight exhaustive collections, reader consensus or present source qualification. The file itself reports substantial blocked sites and inference from tags/stats. Private files named in its index were not read by this reconciliation.

F2: P1–P10 retain native/reborn, outsider, replacement, peer/family, earlier-era, specialist, faction, second-loop, assigned and imported-power possibilities. Current WER11 and later developer/ordinary-life policy own how those seats appear; this old modest-default list does not reverse the current Klein developer route or supply a menu implementation. Era changes actual people, institutions, means and access. A canon date is context for causal event eligibility, not an unconditional scheduled interrupt. The school-year template can support terms, exams and summers where the source does; it does not establish universal exam gates or automatic offline summer progress.

F3: M2/M3 and the strong/weak-inertia table are source hypotheses with the listed limitations, including wiki-only Cradle and unverified chapter pointers. Current OD7/OD8 in [the timeline owner](../TIMELINES_AND_DIVERGENCE.md) govern uptake: preserve causes, local untouched knowledge and actual information channels. A few days is not a global Mother of Learning knowledge expiration; nearby intervention does not inherently scramble memory. Similar major events need surviving causes or actual world-supported correction, not guaranteed canon restoration or a mandatory compensating catastrophe. Memory, truth and reliability differ. Late protagonists can be peers, distant actors or risks through actual access and motives, rather than universal hostile hazards.

F4: M6 and the technique template's hard caps/mastery1–5 are examples from fan premises, not accepted limits or a mandatory ten-field engine. Current AD5/AD38 and world-specific reason/cost allow stronger, free or exceptional means. Audience dislike of effortless power cannot impose balance on Weibao's game. M7 describes a source-specific character risk requiring evidence, motive and opportunity; usefulness alone cannot mandate automatic betrayal. Keep specialist/civilian careers and late-era lives as useful independent design space.

F5: Preserve all mechanic candidates, while reading numerical Gu modifiers, feeding inventory caps, fear/existence graphs, three revival flags, diet/heat/Rc abstractions, corpse recovery10–20percent, speech locks and inherited Authority through their selected source/version owners before use. Their one-line engine shapes are lossy proposals, not implemented or complete franchise laws. Finite economies, ordinary/obscure progression, knowledge hazards and run structures can share seams without becoming a multiverse-global rule. No new franchise verification, source acquisition, dispatch, gameplay, deletion, commit or push occurred.
reviews.evidence: Actual full1–168 read; timeline owner1–130 inspected for existing OD7/OD8 uptake, no fresh private source read.
reviews.reopen: Use current entry/timeline and selected source owner when a concrete premise is implemented.

reviews.classification: full dated benchmark and proposed OCR intake workflow
reviews.disposition:
F1: Full actual review covers294 lines: D1–D5, all retained benchmark rows and dropped-engine history, action-page result, failures, schema, queue arithmetic, staged work and open checks. This remains a2026-10-22 benchmark/proposal, not a current installation/model recommendation or a new bulk-run authorization. All103 pages used Apple Vision,30 used the detector, three had word-bag scoring and a fourth action page had item scoring. Agent-generated gold, familiar-series recall, no independent annotator and unscored ordering limit accuracy claims; word-bag recall/precision is not faithful order, speaker identification or scene truth.

F2: D1's OCR-first/selective-vision route supersedes the playbook's earlier synthetic-test LM2/LM8 bulk-vision proposal for this English pilot only. Preserve raw OCR, corrected text and attributed speaker provenance separately; confidence and box overlap are triage signals, not correctness certificates. Detector coverage1054/1089 does not score missed boxes or order. One action page recovering sound effects cannot establish full-series accuracy. The opening says three double spreads in chapter1, while the later four-of103 count includes chapter16p10; those scopes are compatible. Spread splitting, right-to-left panels versus English bubble order, raw Japanese, databooks and manhwa field alignment remain untested or proposed. A band-order heuristic is not verified panel order.

F3: The about46000-page/2200-chapter queue and model speeds are dated extrapolations, not current queue state.46000×(.14+.15)seconds is about3.71hours before orchestration; GPU occupancy, model load, retries and review add cost. Local inference being uncharged in tokens does not make it free of time, memory or contention. D1 initially suggests three chapters then queue, while D4 explicitly stops after validation/search sample before queue; read D4 as the narrower historical staged proposal. No queue, model, benchmark, package or environment was started or deleted here.

F4: D2 retains chapter/archive/page/member identities, source-pixel coordinates, group/line IDs, tool/model/prompt revisions, raw/corrected text and unverified flags. Its locator cbz_sha256:page_sha256:group_id remains valid only when the identified bytes and grouping identity are retained. A repacked/re-downloaded archive may change CBZ hash; a changed detector/grouping pass may change group_id even on the same page. Preserve old artifact/version mappings rather than promising a hash locator survives arbitrary re-downloads. The sample header has title/series but does not by itself pin translation/edition/medium; retain those SM-A1 source identities when implementing. This is a schema proposal, not delivered searchable text or a built index.

F5: D5's panel-region parsing,10–15percent overlapping vertical strips,2–8percent panel frequency and cost estimates are unmeasured. Long strips require offsets and actual reading direction for the selected source, not an automatic universal left-to-right assumption. Original UI pattern descriptions may feed design owners after evidence review, without adopting source rules or copying panel art. Japanese/databook tests and selected vision questions need their own bounded validation. Model names, install footprints, scratch paths and ignore-line numbers are historical, not fresh availability checks. Current acquisition/agent-use owners govern any later execution; no private raw text/images were exposed or changed.
